absent: Transport config operations and feature negotiation wire behavior beyond the small helpers.
Bus match and probe and hotplug and device group behavior.
Config lock and queue list lock usage outside initialization.
Stop update flag and free page list and shrinker and out of memory and reporting lifecycle details.
Debug file read and write semantics and filter behavior.
Host acknowledgement timing and error handling beyond wait for completion.
Balloon statistics tag numeric values and host wire layout.
Power management wake source semantics and workqueue scheduling.
Device tree matching on non powerpc transports and parent handling details.

findings.text: Header supplies small feature set helpers available to includers for clearing a set and initializing from one word and comparing two sets and duplicating one set into another.

Public device registration routine binds the device to the virtio bus and initializes the core object and allocates a unique index with a generated name and associates device tree state and initializes locks and queue list and resets then acknowledges the transport and creates debug state before adding the device.
Public teardown and test pair where one removes debug state then unregisters the device then frees the saved index and the other reports bus membership by pointer comparison.
Public driver registration routine checks that a nonzero feature table size has a table and attaches the virtio bus and owner before registering with the driver core.

Public power and reset lifecycle operations cover shutdown without driver callback and freeze with failure preservation and restore through a shared private helper and reset prepare and reset done with optional driver hooks.
Debug hierarchy management covers a top root directory plus per device directories with feature inspection and filter control files and recursive removal on teardown at both levels.
Restricted memory handling exposes one query that always reports true and a mutable global callback initially directed at a helper that always reports false.

All feature helpers operate over the same fixed word count so zeroing and copying cover the whole set and equality requires every word to match and single word initialization clears first then assigns only the first word.

Registration always resets before acknowledging and initializes config disabled and core disabled and no pending change and an empty queue list and marks failed status on any error path after releasing index and device tree reference as appropriate.
Removal disables core config before invoking driver removal and afterwards re acknowledges existence and releases the device tree reference.

Generic shutdown first marks queues unusable to avoid kicks after reset then waits until callbacks observe that state then performs transport reset to tolerate IOMMU isolation and devices that wedge on access after reset.

Freeze and reset prepare disable core config and snapshot any failed status and re enable core if the driver hook fails while restore and reset done share a helper that resets and acknowledges and restores failed marker and finalizes and validates features and calls the driver hook and ensures ready state before re enabling core.

Device tree association succeeds quietly when no parent or no available child exists and otherwise expects exactly one available child whose compatibility string is built from a fixed prefix plus hexadecimal device identifier with incompatible nodes skipped as success after cleanup.
Balloon page number handling scales host page numbers by pages per host unit and a setter fills one entry per subpage starting at the page base with converted values in order.

Growing the balloon is capped to one pfn array at a time and collects pages outside the size lock then under the lock enqueues them and advances both page and pfn counts and notifies the host only when at least one entry was produced.

Shrinking the balloon is capped both to one array and to pages currently held and dequeues under the size lock and updates counts and notifies the host before dropping page references so that must tell host ordering is preserved.

Host exchange builds one scatter element over the valid prefix of the pfn array and adds it as host outbound data and kicks and blocks until the acknowledgement callback observes completion while free page reporting instead adds caller supplied input elements on the reporting queue with the same kick and wait pattern.
Statistics writing stores tag and value after endian conversion with a bounds check on the index and byte conversion shifts page counts by page shift.

One virtual memory statistics variant reports swap activity and faults and out of memory kills and summed allocation stalls and scan and reclaim counters plus optional huge page counters and returns how many entries were written while the alternate variant writes nothing and returns zero.
Top level statistics start from the virtual memory variant count then append free memory and total memory and available memory and file cache size derived from system info and node state.

Wakeup accounting starts an event by setting mask bits and holding the wake source only on transition from idle and processes an event by clearing bits and finishes by releasing the wake source only when no bits remain and processing was active.

Registration initializes a config lock and a queue list lock with an empty queue list and the balloon object carries a stop update lock with a stop flag and a free page list lock with list and block count and a wakeup lock with mask and processing flag and a mutex for size updates.

Balloon size changes hold the balloon mutex across enqueue or dequeue and counter updates and host notification while wakeup start uses an interrupt saving acquisition and process and finish use interrupt disabling acquisition around mask and flag updates.

Balloon device state groups transport pointers and five queues and workqueues with size and statistics and reporting works and update gating and config bitmap and free page list state and command identifiers with stop storage and acknowledgement waiting and held page counts with allocator info and pfn staging array and statistics array and shrinker and out of memory block and reporting queue info and wakeup state.
Virtio bus object carries a fixed name with handlers for matching and device groups and hotplug events and probing and removal and interrupt affinity and shutdown and virtual function counting.

Balloon queue identifiers appear in inflate then deflate then statistics then free page then reporting order with a final count sentinel and config read tags define a command identifier value at zero and the device table matches the balloon identifier with any sub identifier followed by a terminator.

Device status moves from reset to acknowledged at registration and removal expects reset by the driver before re acknowledging and restore moves through reset and acknowledged and optional failed marker and driver present and features accepted and driver ready with failed marking on any error.
Bus shutdown dispatch does nothing without a bound driver and otherwise prefers a driver supplied shutdown hook when present and falls back to the generic broken plus synchronize plus reset sequence.
Wakeup source state is idle with empty mask or active with nonzero mask where concurrent adjust and statistics signals merge by bits and release happens only after all bits clear.
Bus callbacks implement removal and affinity lookup returning null when the transport lacks support and shutdown dispatch and virtual function counting delegated to the parent device.

Module lifecycle verifies that two feature storage views start at the same offset then registers the bus with fatal failure on error and creates debug state while exit removes debug state and unregisters the bus and destroys the index allocator.

Device tree probing warns and fails invalid input when more than one available child exists or when the expected child is missing and treats incompatible nodes as non fatal after releasing the reference.
Removal warns once when transport status remains set after driver removal which indicates the driver did not reset as required.

Balloon growth on allocation failure reports a rate limited diagnostic and delays briefly before stopping the current batch and host queue insertion failures warn once and abandon the current notification without waiting.

Driver registration treats nonzero table size without a table as a fatal programming error and compatibility string construction treats output truncation as fatal and module init enforces feature layout equivalence at build time and compatibility formatting overflow is treated as fatal.
Pfn staging array holds 256 entries and out of memory handling deflates 256 pages at priority 80.

Free page allocation combines no retry with no warning and no reclaim from memory allocation context and pages per host unit derive from host page shift minus balloon shift and hint block order equals maximum page order with byte and page totals derived by shifting.
Wakeup mask reserves the lowest bit for size adjustment and the next bit for statistics.
Config read bitmap position for command identifier is zero and per device debug files use read only mode for inspection files and write only mode for filter control files.
